run_search_data_pretty_print: run the CLI to pretty-print a serialized Doxygen search data file to human-readable output
run_search_data_with_merged_subtrees: run the CLI with --show-merged to display merged subtrees in the search data output
run_search_data_with_lookahead_barriers: run the CLI with --show-lookahead-barriers to display lookahead barriers in the search data output
run_search_data_with_colors: run the CLI with --colors to produce colored output when pretty-printing search data
run_search_data_with_stats: run the CLI with --show-stats to print serialization statistics to stderr alongside the output
